description: This file is a CMake module script designed to locate and configure the systemd library for build integration. It performs checks for systemd using pkg-config, sets relevant variables, and defines an imported target for systemd if found.
external_files: systemd headers and libraries on the system

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Used to locate Python packages; in this context, to check for pkg-config.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the specified modules' presence using pkg-config.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the systemd library on the system.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the path to the systemd headers.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake scripts, e.g., for handling standard args.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles success/failure of locating necessary components, provides standard messaging.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to keep them hidden in GUI configurations.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Defines properties of the imported systemd target, such as link libraries and include directories.
